Because the ceiling is a raw pass/fail count, one more defect would disqualify P4 — a fragility worth flagging, though current data support qualification.

The fallback note naming P2 as fewest-defects fallback is coherent only once P4's five defects are acknowledged. Figure-versus-table consistency remains an open item where delivered pixels do not permit full value checks.

P4
